scenes.title: Home to a Crumbling Mesa
scenes.rationale: The return, patrol news, and private confession form the party’s arrival and discovery of the crisis in Karawa.
scenes.overview: The party returns to grim news and confronts Candrosa about his deception and the failing protections.
scenes.transitionToNext: Candrosa sends them to meet Drikod at the centaur camp.

scenes.title: A Stoneborn from the North
scenes.rationale: A distinct social encounter introduces a new companion whose home is threatened by the same disturbances.
scenes.overview: Drikod introduces himself and explains why the elders of Kunda sent him south.
scenes.transitionToNext: The new group returns to the temple for Candrosa’s full account.

scenes.title: The Missing Heart
scenes.rationale: Candrosa’s account and the negotiations that follow concern one immediate problem: how to recover the Heart and whom to trust with the secret.
scenes.overview: Cintra’s disappearance is revealed; the party presses for disclosure and agrees to the next evening’s ritual.
scenes.transitionToNext: Candrosa leaves to pray and speak with Tharandros; the party begins its own inquiries.

scenes.title: Clues and Preparations in Karawa
scenes.rationale: The user requested merging the evening’s hawk and mirror inquiries with the intervening day of preparations before the ritual.
scenes.overview: The party gathers clues from a hawk and the mirror, then arranges barding, speaks with Tharandros, and prepares for the ritual.
scenes.transitionToNext: At dusk, the party returns to Candrosa for the ceremony.

scenes.title: Shakun’s Fraying Web
scenes.rationale: The ritual and its continuous shared vision form one scene, ending with the abrupt awakening.
scenes.overview: The party enters the blue-flamed pool and sees Dunmar’s protective web tearing around an empty center.
scenes.transitionToNext: They wake to screams as the pursuing shadows attack the mystai.

scenes.title: Shadows in the Sanctuary
scenes.rationale: These three tactical beats comprise one uninterrupted combat in the ritual cavern.
scenes.overview: Caught without gear, the party uses bright light and magic to destroy seven shadows; two mystai die.
scenes.transitionToNext: The final shadows fall, leaving the party and Candrosa to confront the losses.

scenes.title: Mourning and Resolve
scenes.rationale: The aftermath combines the immediate human cost, interpretation of the vision, and the decision to continue seeking the Heart.
scenes.overview: The party tends the dead, discusses remaining mysteries, and prepares for the funeral and the journey south.
